inspection.composition: One leafy branch fills the right third from top to bottom and the left two thirds stay plain, matching the other animal cards.
inspection.material: Generated raster material: pressed broadleaf foliage, tone-on-tone with the paper.
inspection.edges: Single complete canvas; no seamless-repeat claim.
inspection.themes: Each theme is generated on its own paper tone with the foliage kept one or two steps away from it, so both themes sit as quietly as the rest of the collection.
